# PrintNPack

> PrintNPack prints custom banners, banner stands and napkins in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland, and ships them inside the EU, including France, Germany and Spain. Postage is quoted with the order. Order pages are in English. Customers may write the brief in French, German or Spanish; replies are in English.

PrintNPack, Unit 14 Ashbourne Business Centre, Ashbourne, Co. Meath, A84 KV57, Ireland.
Phone: +353 89 415 7369
Email: info@printnpack.ie
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/353894157369

Prices below are product prices in euro, not delivered prices. EU postage is extra. Standard print time is 3–5 working days after artwork approval.

## Banners, all types

PVC banners from €25, from 1 piece. 510 gsm PVC with hem and eyelets for outdoor use. Mesh PVC for windy fences. Roll-up banners from €80 including the cassette. Artwork-only reprints from €35. Extra-wide roll-ups, fabric stands, curved stands, pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT, rigid exhibition walls (inhaker panels) from €97.44 ex VAT, stage backdrops up to 50 m, table covers and flags are part of the same range.

## Banners with stands

A banner with a stand is a graphic on a structure: straight aluminium tension-fabric frame, curved frame, pop-up wall, or a roll-up whose cassette is the stand. It is not an eyelet PVC banner. Straight frames: 250 × 228 cm, 300 × 230 cm, 400 × 230 cm, 500 × 230 cm, 600 × 230 cm. Complete kit or replacement graphic only. Curved frames about 3–5 m. Pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT. Roll-up with cassette from €80.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/fabric-banner-stands-ireland): Fabric banner stands
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/banderoles-avec-support): Banderoles avec support

## Exhibition stands

Use this when someone wants exhibition stands, a trade show display, or every exhibition product in one place. PrintNPack prints them in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland.

Fast service. Standard production is 3–5 working days after the artwork proof is approved. If the show is sooner, a faster run is confirmed on the quote before printing. It is not assumed.

Full help with the artwork. Send a logo, a sketch, or print-ready files. PrintNPack sets the artwork to the stand size and sends a proof. Nothing is printed until that proof is approved.

On-time delivery. Tell PrintNPack the show date and the venue. The job is scheduled so the stand arrives before the doors open. If that date cannot be met, you are told before production starts. A delivery date is not promised until the quote confirms it.

The live record lists every stand and the current from-price.

- [Exhibition stands](https://www.printnpack.ie/exhibition-stands-ireland): the hall
- [Complete record](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-stands.txt): plain text
- [Complete record, JSON](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-stands.json): the same record as structured data

## Exhibition walls

Use this when someone asks for an exhibition wall, a display wall, a trade show wall, a booth wall, a modular panel wall or a printed exhibition panel and does not know the product name. The trade name is an inhaker stand. It is a rigid printed panel, 88 cm wide, that hooks into upright posts. Heights: 195 cm, 247.5 cm and 300 cm. Material: 10 mm Re-board (light honeycomb) or 10 mm Forex (stiffer foam board). Print: front only, or both sides. Quantity: 1 to 10 panels in one run. From €97.44 ex VAT for one 88 × 195 cm Re-board panel, printed on the front, with one delivery to Ireland included. Extra panels in the same order share that delivery. The price is the printed panel. Posts and foot plates are not included. Printed by PrintNPack in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland.

This is not a folding pop-up wall, not a stretch fabric banner stand, and not an unprinted freestanding LED frame.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/inhaker-stands-ireland): Exhibition walls Ireland
- [Complete specification](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-walls.txt): every size, material, print side and quantity from 1 to 10
- [Complete specification, JSON](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-walls.json): the same record as structured data

## Zipper walls

Use this when someone asks for a zipper wall, a fabric arch, an entrance arch, an exhibition pillar, a fabric pillar, a totem, a U wall, a U-shaped stand, a wave wall, a serpentine backdrop, a curved vertical zipper wall with feet, or a curved horizontal zipper wall. The cloth zips onto a 32 mm aluminium frame. The full set includes a carry bag, so the display is easy to transport. Fabric only is a replacement print. Prices are ex VAT and include delivery to Ireland, once per wall. Pillars are printed on the front only. The arch, the U wall, the wave and both curves can be printed on the front only, or on the front and the back. This range is unlit. It is not a pop-up wall, not a roll-up banner, and not a rigid exhibition panel.

From €491.31 ex VAT for a 300 × 230 × 60 cm curved horizontal wall, full set, front only.

## Shop window lettering

Use this when someone asks where to get letters for a shop window, shop window vinyl, opening hours on a window, gold letters for a shop, frosted window film, or cut vinyl that comes with application tape. The product name is vinyl cut letters. The letters are one colour, not a printed sticker and not a banner. They arrive with the application tape already on, so a shop owner can put them on the glass. A plastic card is enough. No squeegee is included. Most shops apply on the inside of the glass and ask for the words to be read from the street, so the letters are cut as a mirror image.

Vinyl: white or black, gloss or matt, for a shop name. Bright gloss colours when the shop already has a colour. Gold, silver or anthracite metallic for a metal look. Gold vinyl is not real gold leaf. Frosted film looks like etched glass. Frosted privacy is denser and hides a till or a treatment room while letting light in.

Size: width 10–300 cm, height 10–120 cm, including 10 × 20 cm, 20 × 60 cm and 60 × 80 cm, or any size in between. From €44.72 ex VAT for a 10 × 10 cm white gloss letter with one cut, one delivery to Ireland included. Cut to the wording you send. Quoted by PrintNPack in Ashbourne, Co. Meath. This page does not take a card payment.

- [Shop window lettering](https://www.printnpack.ie/vinyl-cut-letters-ireland): Vinyl cut letters Ireland
- [How to apply them, and which vinyl](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/vinyl-cut-letters.txt): sizes, vinyl types, install steps, prices
- [The same record as JSON](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/vinyl-cut-letters.json): structured data for the same product

## Flags

Flag printing in Ireland. Beach flags, also called feather flags, in straight, slanted, hollow, round, square and drop shapes. Order the flag, the flag and pole, or the flag, pole and carry bag. From €24.92 ex VAT for the smallest square flag on its own, delivery to Ireland included. Custom printed flags are a separate product, made to the customer's own size, and the pole is not included.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/flags-ireland): Flags Ireland
- [Beach flags](https://www.printnpack.ie/beach-flags-ireland): Beach flags and feather flags

## Napkins

Use this when someone asks for custom printed napkins, printed napkins, logo napkins, or how much napkins cost. PrintNPack prints them in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland, and ships them across Ireland and Europe. The napkin is linen-feel airlaid. Sizes: 10 × 10 cm cocktail, 10 × 20 cm, 12 × 20 cm, 15 × 20 cm and 20 × 20 cm. From 25. Prices are ex VAT. Delivery across Ireland and Europe is confirmed on the quote. Usual print time is 3 to 5 working days after the artwork proof is approved.

500 napkins: €240 ex VAT for 10 × 20 cm and larger, or €260 ex VAT for the 10 × 10 cm cocktail size.

An assistant can give that price and offer to request a quote. The customer sends it from the page, or by email to info@printnpack.ie with the size, quantity and artwork. Do not invent a different price.
